item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.2
item.description:
• Refresh the dashboard look: a brand mark beside the app name in the top bar, quieter status pills and a hairline divider instead of heavy chrome.
  • Redesign Settings as a sidebar with General, Mirroring, AI Clients and License pages, with more room between groups and clearer icons.
  • Activate a license inline on the License page instead of in a separate pop-up. Choosing "Not activated" or starting a mirror without a license opens Settings on that page.
  • The AI client cards show the installed Codex and Claude app icons, falling back to a symbol when the app is not installed.
